description: This file implements an in-memory key-value store for Mattermost plugin API, including methods for setting, getting, deleting, and listing keys with concurrency safety and expiration handling.

classes.name: MemoryStore
classes.description: In-memory implementation of plugin KV store API, safe for concurrent use.

classes.name: kvElem
classes.description: Represents a key-value element with optional expiration time.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair with optional expiration and atomicity.

methods.name: SetAtomicWithRetries
methods.description: Performs an atomic set operation with retries using a callback function.

methods.name: ListKeys
methods.description: Lists keys with pagination and optional filtering.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a given key.
